one_liner: Salesforce B2C Commerce API (SCAPI): REST shopper and admin APIs for enterprise storefronts, reachable only through a licensed B2C Commerce realm; official B2C DX MCP server.
notes: Scoped to B2C Commerce (the product the developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce hint points at); B2B/D2C Commerce on Salesforce core is a different product. auth: Shopper APIs via SLAS, built on OAuth 2.1 grant types incl. authorization_code_pkce with shopper login (user grant) = oauth2; Admin APIs via an Account Manager API client (client id + password/secret -> client_credentials token, no user grant) = other; SLAS trusted-system/agent tokens are also client_credentials. Excluded peripheral credentials: Managed Runtime MRT_API_KEY (deploy API), WebDAV access keys, legacy OCAPI Business Manager user grant (BM username+password in Basic) - a maximal reading could add api_key/basic. access: needs a B2C Commerce realm; the API is 'available at no extra cost' to B2C Commerce customers, on-demand sandboxes require purchased sandbox credits; no free/trial signup -> contact_sales. Salesforce exposes a shared public demo sandbox for Shopper API examples, but that is not working credentials for your own instance. mcp: official B2C MCP / B2C DX MCP Server (npm @salesforce/b2c-dx-mcp, GitHub SalesforceCommerceCloud/b2c-developer-tooling) documented on developer.salesforce.com; some doc versions still flag it Developer Preview. A separate 'Agentic MCP Shopper Tools' pilot requires an account executive.

evidence.quote: The SLAS API is based on grant types defined by the OAuth 2.1 standard.
Learn how to create an API client in Account Manager and use the API client’s credentials to request an access token for the SCAPI Admin APIs.
To access an on-demand sandbox, you must purchase sandbox credits, enable appropriate permissions and users, and configure a client API ID.
For B2C Commerce customers, the API is available at no extra cost.
The B2C Commerce API (SCAPI) is a set of RESTful APIs for building storefronts, merchant tools, and integrations on the B2C Commerce platform.
The MCP provides official B2C Commerce documentation search, live cartridge debugging, log investigation, deployment tools, and general-purpose SCAPI Admin API access.
The credit system provides flexibility so you can use the credits that you purchase the way you want.
